## Contract review

Head-sha: `5dd334645739a7c9bcd215bab72802c00d8fc9dd`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card objectui#6349, its body and all 34 comments (the batch 8 claim `6090897330`, the resumed dev's report `6091679483`, the amendment `6091699602`, the rules they cite in `5548770074`, `6077155250`, `6078948754`, `6081214732` and `6089430007`, and tier notice `5612085492`); PR objectui#12074, its body, its 15-file list and the net diff against `main` at the head (369 lines, +124/−32); the 43 check-runs on the head. The six packages' barrels and `exports` maps at the head were read through the REST contents endpoint, as the batch 6 and 7 records did. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

The ledger `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` goes from 16 rows to 13. Each row, named right or wrong:

1. **`ViewSwitcherProps` — RENAME of the plugin-list side, right.** Two meanings: plugin-view's is the props of the registered `view-switcher` renderer (a `ViewSwitcherSchema` plus host callbacks, keyed on the whole `ViewType`); plugin-list's is the list view's own visualization switcher (`currentView`, `availableViews`, `onViewChange`, keyed on core's `ListViewVisualization`). Dependency edges read at the head: plugin-list's `@object-ui` dependencies do not include plugin-view, and plugin-view's do not include plugin-list, so no re-point is dependency-legal in either direction and the narrower side takes the specific name `ListViewSwitcherProps`. Public surface: plugin-list's `exports` map is `.` only and its barrel has no star export; line 33 now publishes `ListViewSwitcherProps` and `ViewSwitcherProps` is gone from it, while the `ViewSwitcher` and `ViewSwitcherDropdown` components keep their names. plugin-view's barrel still publishes `ViewSwitcherProps` (line 25), unchanged. The published-name removal is not a stop under the claim's wording ("a name something reads through a package entry"): the `Type Check` and `Build & E2E` check-runs on the head are success, which corroborates the 0-reader census, and the shape is the one amendment `6089430007` accepted for `GroupAggregationConfig` in batch 7. Members are untouched by the diff.
2. **`RecordDetailDrawerProps` — RENAME of the plugin-dashboard side, right.** Two drawers: plugin-detail's is the published, editable record drawer (`open`, `recordId`, `dataSource`, save, delete, resize); the dashboard's is the read-only drill drawer of a table widget (`record` may be `null`, `target`, `fields`). plugin-dashboard's dependencies do not include plugin-detail and plugin-detail's do not include plugin-dashboard, so a re-point is not dependency-legal; the narrower side takes `DashboardRecordDetailDrawerProps`. Public surface: plugin-dashboard's `exports` map is `.` only, and its barrel at the head has no star export and no mention of `RecordDetailDrawer`, so neither the old nor the new name was ever importable from `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`. plugin-detail's barrel still publishes `RecordDetailDrawerProps` (line 105). No published name moves.
3. **`PageHeaderComponentProps` — RENAME of the app-shell side, right.** app-shell depends on layout, so a re-point was dependency-legal; the dev's base probe (8 errors: `accentColor`, `sticky` and `data-testid` are not layout members, and the console callers hand rendered nodes where layout takes a string `title` and action definitions) shows two meanings, and the member lists in the diff bear that out. The console's declaration takes `ConsolePageHeaderProps`; layout is the one authority, and its barrel's `export * from './PageHeader'` is unchanged. Public surface: app-shell's root barrel re-exports a named list from `./layout/index.js` (lines 143 to 156) that contains neither `PageHeader` nor either props name, has no star export, and its `exports` map is `.` plus `./styles.css`, so neither name was ever importable from `@object-ui/app-shell`. `app-shell/src/layout/index.ts` now re-exports the new name. No published name moves.
4. **The ledger edit, right.** The diff removes exactly the three rows and puts a "sat here" comment in each one's place, the pattern batches 4 to 7 landed; no other row changes. The gate's verdict on the head is the check-runs'.
5. **Tests beside the sites, right.** `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts` moves its RENAMES entry to `ConsolePageHeaderProps`, so the pin that the spec does not own the name keeps its subject; `PageHeader.subtitle.test.tsx` changes a type import; layout's `spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts` changes a comment. All are re-point-only edits. Layout's JSDoc also corrects the pinned test's citation from `.tsx` to `.ts`, which matches the file list.
6. **Batch 7's rider, done.** The plugin-list icon-map comment now says "the same glyph for the same visualization".
7. **The second commit, right.** It corrects "the renderer of the authored `page:header` node" in the `ConsolePageHeaderProps` JSDoc, the app-shell changeset and the ledger comment. Corroborated at the head: layout's `registerLayout` records that its kebab `page-header` registration is retired (objectui#10859) and that `@object-ui/components` registers `page:header`. Comments and changeset prose only.
8. **Scope fence, held.** No `packages/components/src/ui/**`, no `packages/i18n/**`, no other ledger row. No runtime change: every code hunk in the diff is an interface name or a type argument; `Bundle Analysis` is success and the perf-budget comment on the PR reads PASS.

Gate verdicts, from the 43 check-runs on the head: 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard)`, `dependabot`, the three every earlier batch recorded as expected), 0 failure. Among the successes: `Type Check`, `Test` with its 8 shards and dist pins, `Build & E2E`, `Lint`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `README Export Check`, `Doc Snippet Type Check` and `Line Citation Gate`.

PR shape: draft against `main`, based on `20c6d351` (the claim's ref), mergeable clean; first line `Refs #6349 (batch 8)`, no closing keyword anywhere in the body; two commits, the second is the head, both carry the model-free trailer pair; no model name in the body.

### ② Semver level

- **`Clause-②: yes`** at line 3 of the body, line-initial: right. A published name moves on the plugin-list root.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list: minor`** with a breaking note and the migration (the compiler names the replacement, TS2724): right under the claim's per-package criterion ("minor where a published shape moves or a name leaves, with a breaking note") and objectui AGENTS.md §9; `check-changeset-no-major` is success.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard: patch`** and **`@object-ui/app-shell: patch`**: right. Neither renamed name was ever importable from its package entry (①.2 and ①.3).
- **`@object-ui/layout: patch`**: right. JSDoc only; the type and its members are unchanged, and a changeset is owed because a source file of a released package changed (`Changeset Declaration` success, 9 source files of 4 released packages, 4 changesets).
- plugin-view and plugin-detail are untouched, so no changeset is owed. Right.
- **`.changeset/6349-batch7-plugin-list.md`**: one body sentence, front matter and `@object-ui/plugin-list: minor` unchanged in the diff; accepted on the surface by amendment `6091699602`; `Changeset Overwrite Report` is success. Right.
- Tier notice `5612085492` lifted this card's contract-review-tier requirement; the seat runs the review at this tier because of the `Clause-②: yes` line, as batch 4's record noted.

### ③ Boundary flags

Deviations, each answered:
- **Resume.** The killed run's `cc75cab8d` was kept whole and `5dd334645` was added, with no rewrite and no force-push: the PR lists exactly those two commits and the second is the head; amendment `6091699602` accepts the resume. Answered.
- **Batch 7's pending changeset edited.** Accepted by the amendment; declaration unchanged (② above). Answered.
- **Ablation first attempt a refused no-op.** A local-process note; nothing here rests on it, since the check-runs are the gate verdicts. Answered.
- **Trailers and footer.** Verified on the commits and the body; no model name anywhere. Answered.
- **Not run locally.** The full app-shell suite: `Test`, its 8 shards and `Build & E2E` are success. The console's and other dependants' type-checks: `Type Check` is success. The i18n gates: no locale pack and no `packages/i18n/**` file is in the 15-file list. Answered.
- **Scratch reuse and worktree cleanup.** Not contract matters. Answered.

`out_of_scope_findings`, escalated to the seat (comment-only, no gate reads them, none blocks):
- The stale "(app-shell)" precedent pointers in `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ObjectKanban.tsx` and the `spec-symbol-4650.test.ts` beside each: carry as a named rider on the next batch that touches those files, the way batch 7's `ViewSwitcher` rider was carried into this one. Outside the claim's surface; the history they cite stays true.
- Layout's `PageHeaderComponentProps` JSDoc still ends with the "authored layer vs rendered layer" paragraph, and the subtitle test's header still calls layout's header the rendered layer of `page:header`, although that registration is retired. Pre-existing; this PR edits the paragraphs above it in the same block and leaves this one. A rider candidate for the seat.
- The first commit's message says "layout keeps the name for its page:header renderer"; the second commit and the PR body correct it. A commit message is history and needs no rewrite.
